title: Witnessed drowning suicide and VA denial of his service

tellings.quote: I got out of the Air Force and I witnessed a suicide. Um dude drowned, multiple witnesses. I have the police report.

plain: A former Air Force serviceman named Dylan Borland says that in 2015, after he left the Air Force, he saw a man drown himself in Pittsburgh, with "multiple witnesses," and that he has the police report. He tells Michels this first-hand, and says the Department of Veterans Affairs denied his service record, pointing to his police report, an Air Force performance review and his VA medical records as proof of what he went through.
